name: Cartographer
description: Builds a private map of room-to-room traffic patterns from periodic location samples; it never reveals a live player position.
mechanic: Builds a private map of room-to-room traffic patterns from periodic location samples; it never reveals a live player position.
winCondition: Map a configured number of distinct route segments.

name: Auditor
description: Compares the public task-board totals at two checkpoints and reports whether the displayed progress changed consistently.
mechanic: Compares the public task-board totals at two checkpoints and reports whether the displayed progress changed consistently.
winCondition: Correctly flag a configured number of inconsistent progress reports.

name: Relay
description: Receives one scrambled team signal per round and can decode it into a short, non-player-specific clue.
mechanic: Receives one scrambled team signal per round and can decode it into a short, non-player-specific clue.
winCondition: Decode the required number of team signals.

name: Quartermaster
description: Distributes a limited set of one-use utility tokens to players; each token has a different harmless information effect.
mechanic: Distributes a limited set of one-use utility tokens to players; each token has a different harmless information effect.
winCondition: Allocate every token before the final meeting.

name: Surveyor
description: Runs a room survey that records environmental readings; comparing readings reveals which room changed since the previous survey.
mechanic: Runs a room survey that records environmental readings; comparing readings reveals which room changed since the previous survey.
winCondition: Submit a configured number of accurate room-change reports.

name: Courier
description: Carries a data packet between two randomly selected consoles; the packet's route is visible only to the Courier.
mechanic: Carries a data packet between two randomly selected consoles; the packet's route is visible only to the Courier.
winCondition: Deliver the required number of packets.

name: Archivist
description: Keeps a timestamped private event ledger and can verify the order of two non-player-specific events during a meeting.
mechanic: Keeps a timestamped private event ledger and can verify the order of two non-player-specific events during a meeting.
winCondition: Verify a configured number of event-order questions.

name: Beaconist
description: Places a temporary beacon in a chosen room; teammates see a delayed count of how many players passed through, never identities.
mechanic: Places a temporary beacon in a chosen room; teammates see a delayed count of how many players passed through, never identities.
winCondition: Record traffic at the required number of distinct rooms.

name: Mediator
description: Once per meeting, asks the lobby to answer an anonymous structured poll; results show broad preferences without changing vote weight.
mechanic: Once per meeting, asks the lobby to answer an anonymous structured poll; results show broad preferences without changing vote weight.
winCondition: Complete a configured number of polls.

name: Calibrator
description: Receives a rotating sequence of instrument readings and must match each reading to its correct console.
mechanic: Receives a rotating sequence of instrument readings and must match each reading to its correct console.
winCondition: Calibrate the required number of consoles.

name: Signalwright
description: Links two consoles for a short window; completing a task at either console sends a harmless status ping to the other.
mechanic: Links two consoles for a short window; completing a task at either console sends a harmless status ping to the other.
winCondition: Create the required number of successful console links.

name: Timekeeper
description: Can bookmark the current task-board percentage and later compare it with the new value; it does not rewind players or game time.
mechanic: Can bookmark the current task-board percentage and later compare it with the new value; it does not rewind players or game time.
winCondition: Make the required number of accurate progress comparisons.

name: Counterfeiter
description: Can plant one forged, clearly fictional task-board entry that creates a misleading aggregate progress trend without changing real tasks.
mechanic: Can plant one forged, clearly fictional task-board entry that creates a misleading aggregate progress trend without changing real tasks.
winCondition: Keep the forged entry undiscovered through the configured checkpoint.

name: Echoist
description: Can schedule a non-verbal ambient sound cue in a selected room, creating a false impression that a system event occurred there.
mechanic: Can schedule a non-verbal ambient sound cue in a selected room, creating a false impression that a system event occurred there.
winCondition: Trigger the required number of distinct cues without being identified.

name: Blackout Artist
description: Can apply a patterned display filter to one room's decorative signage, making its symbols temporarily inconsistent while leaving visibility and controls unchanged.
mechanic: Can apply a patterned display filter to one room's decorative signage, making its symbols temporarily inconsistent while leaving visibility and controls unchanged.
winCondition: Cause the required number of incorrect room-symbol reports.

name: Broker
description: Can exchange one private clue token for a different clue token at a hidden console; each exchange changes which information is reliable.
mechanic: Can exchange one private clue token for a different clue token at a hidden console; each exchange changes which information is reliable.
winCondition: Complete the configured number of clue exchanges.

name: Decoyist
description: Can place a temporary false destination marker on the shared map that points to an inactive console.
mechanic: Can place a temporary false destination marker on the shared map that points to an inactive console.
winCondition: Lead the crew to inspect the configured number of false markers.

name: Ledgerist
description: Can delay one public task-board refresh, causing the displayed aggregate to remain stale for a short, announced interval.
mechanic: Can delay one public task-board refresh, causing the displayed aggregate to remain stale for a short, announced interval.
winCondition: Create the required number of stale-board windows.

name: Switchboarder
description: Can swap the labels of two non-critical map panels for a short time; navigation and actual room access remain unchanged.
mechanic: Can swap the labels of two non-critical map panels for a short time; navigation and actual room access remain unchanged.
winCondition: Cause the required number of panel-label mix-ups.

name: Weathermaker
description: Can schedule a cosmetic environmental condition in a room, changing ambient effects but not movement, visibility, or controls.
mechanic: Can schedule a cosmetic environmental condition in a room, changing ambient effects but not movement, visibility, or controls.
winCondition: Activate the required number of distinct room conditions.

name: Misdirector
description: Can publish a misleading but technically true room statistic using a selected time window, encouraging incorrect conclusions.
mechanic: Can publish a misleading but technically true room statistic using a selected time window, encouraging incorrect conclusions.
winCondition: Publish the configured number of misleading statistical summaries.

name: Scrambler
description: Can temporarily reorder the icons on one shared non-gameplay status panel without changing the underlying statuses.
mechanic: Can temporarily reorder the icons on one shared non-gameplay status panel without changing the underlying statuses.
winCondition: Cause the required number of incorrect panel interpretations.

name: Parasitic Signal
description: Can attach a false status tag to a single public console readout; the tag expires after a short interval.
mechanic: Can attach a false status tag to a single public console readout; the tag expires after a short interval.
winCondition: Keep the configured number of false tags active until they expire.

name: Jigsaw
description: Collects fragments generated at randomly selected consoles; each fragment contains part of a unique pattern that only this role can assemble.
mechanic: Collects fragments generated at randomly selected consoles; each fragment contains part of a unique pattern that only this role can assemble.
winCondition: Assemble the complete pattern before the match ends.

name: Pilgrim
description: Receives a private sequence of map landmarks and earns progress only by visiting them in the exact order.
mechanic: Receives a private sequence of map landmarks and earns progress only by visiting them in the exact order.
winCondition: Visit the full landmark sequence in order.

name: Curator
description: Catalogues unusual room-state combinations; each combination counts once and duplicates provide no progress.
mechanic: Catalogues unusual room-state combinations; each combination counts once and duplicates provide no progress.
winCondition: Catalogue the configured number of distinct room-state combinations.

name: Wayfinder
description: Must navigate between changing pairs of distant rooms using only a limited compass hint that updates at intervals.
mechanic: Must navigate between changing pairs of distant rooms using only a limited compass hint that updates at intervals.
winCondition: Complete the required number of route challenges.

name: Collector
description: Finds one of several rotating, non-interactive artifacts placed in rooms; artifacts are unique to this role and do not affect other players.
mechanic: Finds one of several rotating, non-interactive artifacts placed in rooms; artifacts are unique to this role and do not affect other players.
winCondition: Collect the required number of different artifacts.

name: Metronome
description: Receives a private rhythm pattern and must activate marked consoles in time with its beats; missed beats reset only that pattern.
mechanic: Receives a private rhythm pattern and must activate marked consoles in time with its beats; missed beats reset only that pattern.
winCondition: Complete the required number of rhythm sequences.

name: Cartouche
description: Receives a set of symbols and must locate matching symbol pairs on room panels; each pair can be used once.
mechanic: Receives a set of symbols and must locate matching symbol pairs on room panels; each pair can be used once.
winCondition: Match all assigned symbol pairs.

name: Lighthouse
description: Must keep a signal chain alive by visiting whichever of three rotating relay rooms is currently dimmed.
mechanic: Must keep a signal chain alive by visiting whichever of three rotating relay rooms is currently dimmed.
winCondition: Restore the signal chain for the required total duration.

name: Weathervane
description: Tracks a private sequence of ambient conditions and predicts which condition will appear next in a designated room.
mechanic: Tracks a private sequence of ambient conditions and predicts which condition will appear next in a designated room.
winCondition: Make the required number of correct condition predictions.

name: Puzzlewright
description: Receives a multi-step logic grid whose clues are distributed across public room panels; solving it grants progress only to this role.
mechanic: Receives a multi-step logic grid whose clues are distributed across public room panels; solving it grants progress only to this role.
winCondition: Solve the complete logic grid.

name: Time Capsule
description: Stores a private snapshot of a room's public status and must return after a delay to identify what changed.
mechanic: Stores a private snapshot of a room's public status and must return after a delay to identify what changed.
winCondition: Complete the required number of before-and-after comparisons.

name: Nomad
description: Gets a changing itinerary that forbids consecutive visits to the same sector; each valid stop adds to a travel score.
mechanic: Gets a changing itinerary that forbids consecutive visits to the same sector; each valid stop adds to a travel score.
winCondition: Reach the itinerary score threshold before the match ends.
